protocol: 30 mapped corpus-lemma types per corpus, drawn uniformly over types (random.Random(7).sample over the rows of mapping/<corpus>.jsonl in file order), judged by the round-3 agent: correct etymon included yes/no. Uniform over types is harsher than round 2 (token-weighted). Hittite: rows deduplicated by base lemma (homograph markers stripped) before sampling, because TLHdig lemmas carry gloss and homograph markers. Doubtful Wiktionary etymologies are counted as wrong.

surface_to_lemma.protocol: 20 mapped tokens per unlemmatized corpus (random.Random(11)), surface → lemma → etymon judged as a whole; surfaces are not stored.

non.errors: function-word homographs: ok and/yoke (2), á on/river (2), er, í, bað bade/bath, þó; fixed afterwards by treating any lemma with a function-word POS as non-content
